I'd love that! I've got one that's gentle and easy to remember.

It's called "4-7-8" – also known as the "Relaxation Breath". It helps calm your nervous system and slow down your heart rate.

Here it goes: inhale through your nose for a count of 4... filling up your lungs completely... hold it at 7... and exhale slowly through your mouth for a count of 8... emptying out all the air...

Try with me: inhale... (count of 1...2...3...4)... hold... (5...6...7)... exhale... (8...9...10...)

How do you feel after just three breaths?

(By the way, what brings you here today? Not just about the breathing, but if there's something on your mind...)
